mainText: Good morning. It's Monday, October 12th, Columbus Day. Markets are quiet and mixed: S and P 500 futures are up a fraction of a percent, the Dow up a tenth of a percent, and the Nasdaq roughly flat. The bond market is closed today, so the ten year Treasury has no live move — it sits at five point two three seven percent, Friday's level. Earnings season kicks off tomorrow with the big banks, and September consumer price inflation data lands Wednesday. Oil is above a hundred dollars a barrel amid Middle East strikes and energy ceasefire news. Premarket movers: Westlake up over fifteen percent, Core and Main up six percent, and Mirum, C V R Energy, and Idex each up more than four percent. On the downside, Urban Outfitters down almost nine percent on a Citi downgrade, and Primo Brands down about seven percent.
